body: Prove no fast/bevy_dylib in release by a byte scan of the exe for (lib)bevy_dylib/(lib)std-<16hex>.(dll|so) import names in tools/package_release.py; probe: static target/release exe 0 hits, fast target/debug exe hits bevy_dylib.dll + std-*.dll. Rejected: dumpbin (not on PATH, needs vswhere) / readelf (Linux only) / cargo tree (graph, not the binary).

Linux boot smoke runs the exe from the unzip-ed release (cwd elsewhere, CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/BEVY_ASSET_ROOT removed) under xvfb + mesa lavapipe (WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan) and requires the bevy_render AdapterInfo line, a new info! 'main menu ready' marker in spawn_main_menu, liveness at the deadline and zero ERROR/panicked lines. Rejected: bare liveness (a hang before the first update looks alive) and a new --smoke/--version CLI mode in the game (product code for CI only).

No boot smoke on the Windows runner: WARP/dx12 on a session-0 runner is unproven and a flaky release gate blocks releases; Windows boot is verified by QA locally from the downloaded release zip with the same smoke script. Alternative (continue-on-error WARP smoke) rejected as a non-gate.

Linux release built on pinned ubuntu-24.04 (glibc 2.39 floor, documented), Windows on pinned windows-2025. Rejected: ubuntu-latest (silently moves to 26.04 and raises the glibc floor) and ubuntu-22.04 (older glibc but the image is next in line for retirement).

Publish with the preinstalled gh CLI and GITHUB_TOKEN in a separate publish job (contents: write only there, needs build+gates). Rejected: softprops/action-gh-release (third-party action with write token) and per-build-job uploads (a half-published release if one OS fails).

Keep .cargo/config.toml rust-lld.exe for the Windows release (same link as the owner's local --release; config has no Linux section). Fallback if the runner link fails: CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_MSVC_LINKER=link.exe in the Windows matrix entry only. Rejected: switching the release link to link.exe up front.

Triggers: push tags v* (release), push branches with a paths filter on release-relevant files (build+package+smoke+artifacts, no publish), workflow_dispatch (artifacts; only works once release.yml is on main). Headless gates job runs only on tags because sim/citygen gates workflows already run on every branch push but not on tag pushes. Rejected: running on every main push (30+ min Windows build on docs commits).

Windows release exe is built with +crt-static via CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_PC_WINDOWS_MSVC_RUSTFLAGS in the Windows matrix entry only, and verify rejects VCRUNTIME140/api-ms-win-crt imports. Rejected: shipping the dynamic CRT with a README note (the local release exe imports VCRUNTIME140.dll; a clean Windows dies before main, and QA's host cannot see it); rejected: rustflags in .cargo/config.toml (changes the owner's local and fast builds).

Windows boot smoke on the runner (WGPU_BACKEND=dx12, menu run only) is attempted in the first branch run and kept as a gate if green; removal on an environment failure is logged as dead_end. Rejected: no Windows CI smoke at all (Bevy's own example-run CI runs examples with dx12 on windows-latest, so the 'unproven' premise is wrong).

publish and release-gates run only on event_name == push with a refs/tags/v ref. Rejected: ref-only condition (a workflow_dispatch on a tag ref would publish, the spec says dispatch uploads artifacts only).
